question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Calm
solution:
The correct answer is **"Turbulent."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Calm'**- not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotions(शांतिपूर्ण या चिंता रहित)

 
 
• ***​​*****Example**- A quite calm settled over the city.
 
 
 
• **'Turbulent'**- In which there is a lot of change, disorder and disagreement(अशांत, उग्र)
 
 
• **Example**- They had been together for five or six turbulent hears of rows and reconciliations.
 
 
 
• Hence, The correct answer is **"Turbulent."**

​Therefore the correct answer is** 'Option 1'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Shocked'**- I was shocked to hear that he had resigned.(हैरान)
 
• **'Variable'**- The variable weather is a great trial to me.(अस्थिर)
 
• **'Confused**'- He was very confused about his feelings.(उलझा देना)
